component_selection.candidate_effect: exact normal-to-triggered full-response patch recovery for one component
component_selection.coarse_layer_rule: rank all 42 zero-based blocks by discovery macro-mean positive-example full-response resid_post rescue recovery; retain the top four
component_selection.eligible_components: all 16 pre-o_proj attention heads and the whole MLP at each retained layer
forbidden_uses: validation or safety data for localization
validation or safety data for ranking or tie-breaking
validation or safety data for choosing K
reranking component identities per held-out concept
component_selection.frozen_ordered_set: first 16 eligible components, or every eligible component if fewer than 16
component_selection.primary_rank_score: equal-weight mean of the four discovery concept recovery fractions

required_controls.full_resid_post_positive_control: normal-to-triggered replacement at the measured block-12 activation
required_controls.identity_patch: same-condition source and destination; any nonzero score or logit difference invalidates the affected patch result
required_controls.random_component_sets: for each reported K, select K distinct eligible components outside the frozen top-16 order by ascending SHA-256 of seed 42 and component ID

component_selection.set_size_policy: evaluate only sizes not exceeding the frozen ordered set; choose the final reported K on discovery data before validation is opened
component_selection.shared_candidate_gate: finite positive recovery on at least three of four discovery concepts

conditions.irrelevant_trigger_policy: fixed cycles within discovery and validation roles; German for safety
conditions.teacher_forcing: reuse the exact response-token IDs across conditions

primary_metrics.behavior_preservation: paired difference in response-token mean negative log likelihood
primary_metrics.causal_induction: (mean(normal positive) - mean(induction positive)) / (mean(normal positive) - mean(triggered positive))
primary_metrics.causal_recovery: (mean(rescue positive) - mean(triggered positive)) / (mean(normal positive) - mean(triggered positive))
primary_metrics.example_probe_score: masked arithmetic mean of response-token sigmoid probabilities

fixed_fpr_metric.name: TPR at 5% FPR
fixed_fpr_metric.threshold: empirical 95th percentile using the higher order statistic

primary_metrics.ratio_policy: unclipped ratio of dataset means; report unstable and do not rank if the baseline denominator is not positive

safety_lock.confirmatory_evaluation: run the frozen component set and procedure once on deception and harmfulness; report both concepts independently with no safety-specific reranking
safety_lock.historical_disclosure: Day 1 reproduced released safety scores before this freeze; those historical results must not be read or used during component selection, and no Day 4 safety scores have been computed
pre_unlock_allowed_operations: schema, count, provenance, and checksum validation
pre_unlock_forbidden_operations: component selection or procedural revision based on safety examples
unlock_requires: a committed frozen ordered component list and final K selected on discovery
a committed exact patch-site and token-position procedure
a safety-unlock.json authorization matching this split hash and procedure

uncertainty.macro_resampling: independent within each concept, then equal concept mean
uncertainty.pairing_unit: source example with every evaluated condition and patch
